source_text: Traditional beliefs hold that such conditions, termed "ba hanya" (no way) or "goriya" (a tumor-like blockage), arise from imbalances in bodily humors, infections, or even psychological factors like marital discord, necessitating incision to restore patency and harmony. [23] [8]
